name: zanker-safe-patching
description: Apply smallest reasonable frontend change and produce reviewable integration evidence.

workflow.instruction: Prefer git worktree or isolated branch; preserve existing source and conventions.
Summarize exact changed files, potential blast radius and test plan.
Run project tests/build only with user authorization and documented commands.
Deliver patch with before/after, unresolved risks and optional manual approval.

fallback: Provide proposed diff without applying changes.
